KABIR MALHOTRA
PGP 2025-27 | Indian Institute of Management Calcutta | kabirm2027@email.iimcal.ac.in

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS
PGP, IIM Calcutta, 2025-27, CGPA 8.2/10 (Top 10% of batch)
B.Com (Hons), Shri Ram College of Commerce, 2025, 9.1/10 (Rank 3)
CAT 2024: 99.86 percentile

SUMMER INTERNSHIP
Bain & Company, New Delhi | Summer Associate | Apr - Jun 2026
- Market-entry assessment for a Japanese two-wheeler EV maker in India: sized the electric scooter market across 40 cities and built a city-prioritisation model on charging density and ownership cost
- Interviewed 35 dealers and 12 fleet operators; findings shifted the client's launch city list from Delhi NCR first to Pune and Bengaluru first
- Received Pre-Placement Offer (PPO)

CORPORATE INTERNSHIP
Kotak Mahindra Bank | Strategy Intern | May - Jul 2024
- Benchmarked 6 private banks' credit card rewards programs and recommended cutting 2 low-use reward categories

CASE COMPETITIONS
- National Winner, HUL L.I.M.E. Season 16 (2026): rural distribution of a premium detergent; 1 of 3 winners from 21,000 teams
- National Finalist, Flipkart WiRED 7.0 (2025)
- Campus Winner, ITC Interrobang Season 14 (2025)

POSITIONS OF RESPONSIBILITY
- Coordinator, Consult Club, IIM Calcutta: ran 12 case-prep sessions for 140 first-years
- General Secretary, Commerce Society, SRCC (2023-24): led a 30-member team; raised INR 8 lakh in sponsorship for the annual fest

EXTRACURRICULAR
- State-level chess player (Delhi, U-19)
inputs.jd_text:
Summer Associate / Associate - Management Consulting
A leading global strategy consulting firm, India offices (Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru)

About the role
You will work in small teams with clients across consumer goods, financial services, industrials and technology to solve their most important strategic and operational problems.

Responsibilities
- Structure ambiguous business problems and develop hypotheses
- Gather and analyse data, including market sizing, customer interviews and financial models
- Synthesise insights and present recommendations to senior client stakeholders
- Work effectively in teams and contribute to a culture of collaboration

What we look for
- Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills
- Strong communication skills, written and verbal
- Demonstrated leadership in academic, extracurricular or professional settings
- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity
- MBA from a top-tier business school

plan.warmup_question: What have you been working on or learning lately at IIM Calcutta?
plan.background_question: Walk me through your background, from SRCC through IIM Calcutta and the experiences that led you toward consulting.

slots.core_question: I see that your Bain work influenced the client’s launch-city priorities. What did you personally do to reach that recommendation?
slots.intent_private: Needs a specific account of Kabir’s own research and analysis, the reasoning behind the city recommendation, and how the client decision changed.
likely_probes: Which part of the market-entry work did you personally own?
What would you do differently now after completing that internship?
How did you decide that interviewing 35 dealers and 12 fleet operators was sufficient?

slots.core_question: At Kotak Mahindra Bank, you worked on credit-card rewards. How did you arrive at your recommendation?
slots.intent_private: Needs the comparison logic, the criteria Kabir used to identify low-use categories, and the personal judgment behind recommending their removal.
likely_probes: Which parts of the recommendation did you personally decide?
What did you compare the two low-use categories against?
What evidence would have changed your recommendation?

slots.core_question: You were a national winner in HUL L.I.M.E. What was your personal contribution to the winning solution?
slots.intent_private: Needs a concrete account of Kabir’s role in the rural-distribution solution, the assumptions he shaped, and how the team handled an ambiguous business problem.
likely_probes: What part of the HUL solution did you personally own?
Which assumption most influenced your recommendation?
What evidence supported the solution you presented?

slots.core_question: As General Secretary of the Commerce Society, how did you lead the sponsorship effort?
slots.intent_private: Needs a specific leadership story covering Kabir’s approach to the 30-member team, key stakeholder decisions, and how the INR 8 lakh outcome was achieved.
likely_probes: Which people decision mattered most in leading the 30-member team?
How did you decide where to focus the sponsorship effort?
What did INR 8 lakh represent compared with your target?
